imsg.headerMissing: Column {col} is missing from the header row.
imsg.unknownRef: {col} {value} is not in the locations or case types: add it in Admin, or correct the row.
imsg.nameCase: {col} "{value}" differs from "{known}" only in capitals; ids are used, so nothing changes.
imsg.cityCase: City name "{value}" has inconsistent capitals; joined on {cityId} instead.
imsg.notAllowed: {col} "{value}" is not one of {list}: the case is imported without it.
imsg.notDateTime: {col} "{value}" is not a date and time: use {format} (Riyadh time) or {iso}.
imsg.notWhole: {col} "{value}" is not a whole number of {min} or more.
imsg.tooLarge: {col} "{value}" is too large: use {limit} or less.
imsg.parties: Only {n, plural, one {# party} other {# parties}} involved.
imsg.partiesToConfirm: {n, plural, one {# party} other {# parties}} involved. Meaning to be confirmed by the {customer}.
imsg.caseNumber: CaseNumber "{value}" does not start with a two-letter city code.
imsg.duplicate: {idCol} {value} is also on row {row}; one row per {idCol} is imported (the first without errors).
imsg.assignedBefore: Assigned {n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before it was registered.
imsg.arrivedNoAssign: {assignedCol} is empty but {arrivalCol} is set: the case counts as remote (inferred).
imsg.arrivedBefore: Arrived before the case was registered.
imsg.closedBefore: Closed before the case was registered.
imsg.dayOutlier: {date} has {n} cases against a median of {median} a day: a missing or doubled extract? (outlier)

imsg.outsideArea: Latitude {lat}, Longitude {lon} is outside the service area: the case keeps them.
imsg.capped: {n} rows in all ({inner}) Only the first {max} are listed.
imsg.cappedLike: {n} rows in all like row {row} ({inner}) Only the first {max} are listed.
imsg.blankLines: {n, plural, one {# empty line was} other {# empty lines were}} skipped (the first is line {first}).
imsg.fileEmpty: The file is empty: it needs a header row.
imsg.noDataRows: The file has a header row and no data rows.
imsg.assignedBeforeType: Assigned {n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before it was registered ({type} case).
